note: Rooks County (20163) publishes no public queryable parcel service. The appraiser's GIS page says parcel layers and shapefiles are provided by an outside vendor for a charge. The only state-hosted option, ORKA (kansasgis.org/orka), requires accepting an Open Records Act disclaimer and offers downloads one county at a time; no ArcGIS REST parcel layer for Rooks was found. Commercial sources (Regrid, Acres, Dynamo) are paid. Neighbouring Ellis County's service on geodataportal.net covers Ellis only.
